reference.code: pub fn schedule_slots(s:i32,e:i32,d:i32,b:&[[i32;2]])->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s<0||e<0||s>10000000||e>10000000||s>e||d<=0||d>10000000||b.iter().any(|x|x[0]<0||x[1]<0||x[0]>10000000||x[1]>10000000||x[0]>x[1]){return None}let mut a:Vec<_>=b.iter().filter(|x|x[1]>s&&x[0]<e).map(|x|[x[0].max(s),x[1].min(e)]).collect();a.sort();let(mut o,mut p)=(vec![],s);for x in a.into_iter().chain([[e,e]]){while p+d<=x[0]{o.push(p);p+=d}p=p.max(x[1])}Some(o)}
